newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Texaco named operator of Angolan oil field.
newsitem.headline: Texaco named operator of Angolan oil field.

text.p: U.S. oil company Texaco Inc has been named operator of a new deepwater oil field off Angola's coast, a company official said on Friday.

"We have been awarded operator of Block 22. This is our first deep water block and we are very pleased. We feel that the future of oil exploration in Angola is in deep water," the official told Reuters.
Texaco is also operator on Angola's Block Two with state oil company Sonangol, French oil company Total, and Brazil's Petroleo Brasileiro SA.
It is a shareholder on an onshore production field near Angola's northern port city of Soyo and offshore on blocks 16 and 20.
Angola ranks fourth in the world as suppliers of oil to the United States.
